data.spec: Implemented internal bus.add_listener(callback,*,source)->idempotent unsubscribe and publish(event,data,*,source=None); source identity isolates app/database listeners, SSE wire payload unchanged. Feedback registers/unregisters with API lifespan; task.updated/requests.updated/state.changed/facility.updated synchronously capture feed before polling, including all facility producers. Listener failures log generic text only and don't abort domain actions; polling is recovery fallback. Native order/ticket completion and legacy request resolve now mutate under shared lock, update task timestamp, capture exact request. Native nonexistent order/ticket completion returns404. WhatsApp pending atomically claimed before HTTP (no lock held during send); stale actionable prompts/recovered alerts skipped. Restart distinguishes never-attempted pending(skipped history) from attempted uncertain(unchanged/no retry). No dashboard edits in this follow-up.
